verdict.rationale: Framer's own docs describe automatic version history with rollback, saying every site change is saved and any version can be restored in seconds. That covers the 'restore any earlier state' part. Nothing documents naming milestones or comparing versions; branching (review and merge) is a related feature, not version comparison. missing for 10: naming/labeling milestones, side-by-side comparison or diff of versions, independent or hands-on corroboration of restore

support.subject: As a designer, full version history lets me name milestones, compare, and restore any earlier state of a file

citations.quote: Version history and rollback. Every site change is saved automatically, so you can restore any version in seconds.
